keyEvents.text: Fricio Caicedo (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Santiago Rodríguez (Columbus Crew) is shown the yellow card for handball.
First Half ends, Columbus Crew 0, Inter Miami CF 0.
